action_items: Optional: pre-existing test flakes in backend_test.py (TestOrdersManualItems.test_receive_partial_manual_creates_product) and test_toolholders.py (TestToolHolderIndependent.test_creating_toolholder_does_not_create_product) fail under -n auto parallel run because they read/count all products/orders without scoping to test-created data. They pass in isolation. Consider scoping asserts by test-created ids or serial-marking these tests.

Optional: backend_test.py::TestSeedAndSchema::test_products_no_unit_price_on_new_yzk asserts len(products) >= 1 which fails when DB was freshly wiped (iter6). Either seed data on demand in the fixture or remove/relax the assertion.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stock_out no longer sends critical email (comment on line 678 documents the intentional removal) — good.

toolholder_import matches on (name, brand, type) — brand/type optional in query, so name-only rows will match ANY existing holder with same name regardless of brand — acceptable but could accidentally collapse legitimate duplicates. Consider always requiring brand+type in the uniqueness key for safety.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — should migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers (pre-existing, not iter7).
